text:
I go to the cinema with my friends yesterday.

She take the bus to work every single morning.

We arrived to the station at eight in the morning.

I went to cinema with my brother last night.

I recieve your letter yesterday morning at home.

I go there. She stays here every day of the week.

They gave me a advice about the new job.

I look forward to hearing from you very soon.

The weather in London was warm and quite pleasant.

He is a very good and friendly teacher indeed.

Please let me know what you think about it.
